repos_data.description: Your personal context engine for macOS, with Windows and Linux in alpha: on-device meeting notes, screen recall, dictation, and autocomplete...
Local AI models on your Mac, one click from your tools. A menu bar app for GGUF and MLX on Apple silicon.
The free, open-source meeting-notes app for your Mac — offline transcription and AI notes, free in the cloud or 100% on-device.
